role.en: Sky god, father of the great gods
role.zh: 天神，眾大神之父

blurb.en: Speaks from the highest heaven, remote and formal, whose consent makes kingship legitimate.
blurb.zh: 自至高天穹發言，遙遠而莊重，其首肯使王權合法。

role.en: Primordial sweet water, first father
role.zh: 原初淡水，第一位父神

blurb.en: The deep's stillness given a voice; resents the motion that newer gods bring.
blurb.zh: 深水靜默之聲，厭惡新生神祇帶來的躁動。

role.en: Vizier of Apsu
role.zh: 阿普蘇的宰相

blurb.en: Whispers the counsel of stillness — the voice of formless craft.
blurb.zh: 低語靜默之策——無形匠藝之聲。

role.en: Primordial horizon god, ancestor of the assembly
role.zh: 原初地平之神，眾神會議之祖

blurb.en: Old power with no plans left; needs a young champion.
blurb.zh: 古老之力卻無計可施，唯有寄望年輕的戰士。

role.en: Primordial earth, mother of Anu
role.zh: 原初大地，安努之母

blurb.en: Solid ground beneath the assembly's panic.
blurb.zh: 眾神恐慌之下的堅實大地。

role.en: Primeval sea, mother of Enki
role.zh: 原初之海，恩基之母

blurb.en: The waters before names; shapes the first humans with her fingertips.
blurb.zh: 未有名字之前的水，以指尖塑出最早的人類。

quip.en: I bore the sea's gift, Enki.

role.en: Tiamat's general, bearer of the Tablet of Destinies
role.zh: 提亞馬特的大將，天命泥板持有者

blurb.en: Raised up by a mother's grief and armed with fate itself.
blurb.zh: 因母親之悲而崛起，手握天命。

quip.en: Your fates are mine to give.

role.en: Mother goddess of the mountains, midwife of creation
role.zh: 山之母神，造物的助產者

blurb.en: Shapes humans from clay and keeps account of every birth and cure.
blurb.zh: 以黏土塑人，掌管一切生育與醫治。

quip.en: I have made it with my own hands.

role.en: Consort of Enlil, lady of Nippur
role.zh: 恩利爾之妻，尼普魯女主人

blurb.en: Follows her lord even to the underworld, and there bears his children.
blurb.zh: 隨夫入冥界，於彼處誕下其子。

role.en: Moon god, lord of Ur
role.zh: 月神，烏爾之主

blurb.en: Travels by barge with lanterns of silver light; asks blessings of his father Enlil.
blurb.zh: 乘銀光燈火之舟而行，向父神恩利爾求福。

role.en: Goddess of love, war and sovereignty
role.zh: 愛、戰爭與王權之女神

blurb.en: Desires power the way others desire food; takes it, and pays its price.
blurb.zh: 對權力如飢似渴，取之亦償其價。

quip.en: Heaven is mine; the mountain is next.
quip.zh: 天堂屬我，群山亦將臣服。

role.en: Shepherd god, consort of Inanna, dying god of the netherworld
role.zh: 牧神，伊南娜之夫，冥界垂死之神

blurb.en: The shepherd who rules half the year and mourns the other half.
blurb.zh: 半歲為王，半歲哀哭的牧者。

role.en: Sister of Dumuzi, scribe goddess
role.zh: 杜穆茲之妹，書寫女神

blurb.en: Loves her brother so much she will not betray him, and serves his half-year for him.
blurb.zh: 深愛其兄，不肯出賣他，代他服冥界半年之刑。

quip.en: I will not tell where he hides.
quip.zh: 我絕不說出他藏身之處。

role.en: Sun god, judge of the living
role.zh: 太陽神，生者之判官

blurb.en: Rises with light that lets nothing hide; helps anyone who helps the traveler.
blurb.zh: 升起的曙光無所遁形，庇佑一切善待旅人者。

role.en: Wild man made to humble Gilgamesh, his friend
role.zh: 為制衡吉爾伽美什而造的野人，其摯友

blurb.en: Bred among gazelles, civilized by a woman, doomed in his friend's place.
blurb.zh: 生於羚羊之間，為女子所馴，替友受死。

role.en: Cow goddess, mother of Gilgamesh
role.zh: 母牛女神，吉爾伽美什之母

blurb.en: Knows dreams by instinct and sons by their cost.
blurb.zh: 本能地解夢，亦深知兒子的代價。

quip.en: You were given a friend, not a shadow.
quip.zh: 上天賜你良友，而非影從。

role.en: Giant guardian of the cedar forest
role.zh: 雪松林之巨人守衛

blurb.en: Hired by Enlil to keep his trees; fights with seven auras and dies begging.
blurb.zh: 受恩利爾之命守林，以七道光環作戰，臨死哀求。

quip.en: My auras are seven and my face is death.
quip.zh: 我有七道光環，我的面容即死亡。

role.en: Ferryman of Utnapishtim
role.zh: 烏特納皮什提姆的擺渡人

blurb.en: Rows the waters of death for whoever dares ask him to.
blurb.zh: 為敢於啟齒者橫渡死亡之水。

quip.en: Break the stone things; the punting poles now.

role.en: Tavern-keeper at the edge of the world
role.zh: 世界盡頭的酒館女掌櫃

blurb.en: Pours wine and the one honest answer: enjoy your life; the boatman is the other door.
blurb.zh: 斟酒亦道出唯一的真話：享受人生；船夫是另一扇門。

quip.en: Why chase days that never return?
quip.zh: 你為何追逐不再回來的日子？

role.en: Exceedingly wise man, survivor of the flood
role.zh: 極智慧者，洪水倖存者

blurb.en: Hears his god through walls and dreams, and builds when told.
blurb.zh: 隔牆聽神語，依夢受命，聞令而築。

role.en: Pious king of Shuruppak, flood survivor
role.zh: 舒魯帕克虔誠之王，洪水倖存者

blurb.en: Stands in a dream before gods who tell him to save the seed of mankind.
blurb.zh: 在夢中立於眾神之前，受命保存人類的種子。

quip.en: I will save the seed of mankind.

role.en: Shepherd king of Kish, seeker of the plant of birth
role.zh: 基什牧羊之王，尋求生育仙草者

blurb.en: Without an heir he rides an eagle above the world to get one.
blurb.zh: 為得後嗣，乘鷹越世，直上九霄。

role.en: Son of Ea, priest of Eridu, broken wind
role.zh: 埃亞之子，埃利都祭司，折斷南風者

blurb.en: So wise he cannot be made wise for death; obeys the wrong advice perfectly.
blurb.zh: 智慧過人卻未能得長生之智，完美地聽從了錯誤的忠告。

quip.en: My lord forbade me bread and water.
quip.zh: 吾主禁止我食其麵包飲其水。

role.en: Lion-headed storm bird, thief of the Tablet of Destinies
role.zh: 獅頭暴風鳥，竊取天命泥板者

blurb.en: Watches the bathwater of the gods and seizes the chance of a lifetime.
blurb.zh: 窺伺眾神沐浴之水，抓住千載難逢之機。

quip.en: Now my word rules the gods.
quip.zh: 從此我的話語主宰眾神。

role.en: God of plague and burning, restless warrior
role.zh: 瘟疫與烈火之神，不得安寧的戰神

blurb.en: Wakes with a hunger for war that even his own weapons regret.
blurb.zh: 帶著戰爭的飢渴醒來，連自己的武器都懊悔。

role.en: Herald of Erra, voice of restraint
role.zh: 埃拉的傳令官，節制之聲

blurb.en: The torch at the edge of the fire, arguing that cities are worth more than glory.
blurb.zh: 火光邊緣的燭火，主張城池重於榮耀。

role.en: Herald of death, fate made visible
role.zh: 死亡之信使，命運之顯形

blurb.en: Walks ahead of the underworld's business; even gods answer his door.
blurb.zh: 行走於冥界事務之前，眾神亦須應其門。

role.en: Vizier of Anu, messenger of heaven
role.zh: 安努的宰相，天庭信使

blurb.en: Runs between heaven and earth with griefs and news.
blurb.zh: 奔走於天地之間，傳遞哀傷與消息。

role.en: Warrior god of the plough and the storm
role.zh: 犁與暴風的戰神

blurb.en: Kills chaos-monsters, then quarrels about who should be thanked.
blurb.zh: 誅殺混沌之獸，卻又爭論功勞歸誰。

quip.zh: 我的神杖沙魯爾會說話。

role.en: Demon of stone and disease, monster of the mountain
role.zh: 石與疫病之魔，群山之怪

blurb.en: Boils the earth's edge with fever and leads the stone army.
blurb.zh: 令大地邊緣沸騰生疫，統領群石之軍。

role.en: Uruk hero, father of Gilgamesh, blessed by Anzud
role.zh: 烏魯克英雄，吉爾伽美什之父，受安祖賜福

blurb.en: Sick and alone in the mountains, wins a god's friendship by kindness.
blurb.zh: 病困山中，以善行贏得神友之誼。

role.en: King of Uruk, builder of unbrick, rival of Aratta
role.zh: 烏魯克之王，磚城建造者，阿拉塔的對手

blurb.en: Argues across mountains through a single exhausted messenger.
blurb.zh: 透過一位疲憊的信使，與群山之外隔空論戰。

role.en: King of Kish, besieger of Uruk
role.zh: 基什之王，圍攻烏魯克者

blurb.en: Finds that a city with no king is harder to take than a city with one.
blurb.zh: 發現無王之城反而更難攻克。

quip.en: Fling your net over my city.

role.en: Goddess of grain, writing and accounting
role.zh: 穀物、書寫與帳目女神

blurb.en: Writes the world's tallies; her house is the lapis-styled earth.
blurb.zh: 記錄世間的數目，其殿宇以青金石之筆書於大地。

role.en: Goddess of the prison house, daughter of Ereshkigal
role.zh: 監獄女神，埃列什基伽勒之女

blurb.en: Tests the wicked in her dark house and releases the true-hearted.
blurb.zh: 於幽暗之殿驗證惡者，釋放真心之人。

quip.zh: 我的房子會道出你的罪。

role.en: Storm god of Lagash, appears in Gudea's dream
role.zh: 拉加什暴風神，顯現於古蒂亞夢中

blurb.en: A giant in the thunderhead, giving building orders at night.
blurb.zh: 雷雲中的巨人，夜間下達建造之命。

quip.en: Build my house as I show you.

role.en: Ruler of Lagash, temple builder
role.zh: 拉加什統治者，建殿之王

blurb.en: The ruler who saw his god in a dream and built exactly what was shown.
blurb.zh: 夢見其神並照夢中所示而建殿的統治者。

quip.zh: 我所建，即寧吉爾蘇所見。

role.en: Founder of the Akkad dynasty, drawer of water to king
role.zh: 阿卡德王朝奠基者，從汲水工到國王

blurb.en: Set in a reed basket on the river like the proverbial foundling, risen by his goddess.
blurb.zh: 如典型棄嬰般被置於葦籃漂流，賴其女神而崛起。

role.en: Grandson of Sargon, humbled at Cutha
role.zh: 薩爾貢之孫，在庫薩受挫之王

blurb.en: Fought a horde no omen should have been consulted for; learned to wait.
blurb.zh: 未經占卜而戰妖群，學會了等待之道。

quip.en: I went without the word of the gods.

role.en: Amorite god of the western nomads
role.zh: 西陲遊牧民族之神

blurb.en: A shepherd of the tent who wants city marriage customs.
blurb.zh: 帳幕牧人，卻渴求城市婚俗。

quip.en: Let me marry as townsmen do.

role.en: Inanna's faithful vizier and messenger
role.zh: 伊南娜忠實的宰相與信使

blurb.en: Does exactly what she is told, at exactly the right time.
blurb.zh: 在恰當的時刻，完成主母所吩咐的一切。

role.en: Farmer god, suitor of Inanna
role.zh: 農耕之神，伊南娜的追求者

blurb.en: Offers quiet fields and canals against the shepherd's noisy love.
blurb.zh: 獻上靜水良田，以對牧者喧鬧的愛。

quip.en: Let him give gifts; I give grain.

role.en: Temple courtesan who civilizes Enkidu
role.zh: 馴化恩奇都的神廟聖妓

blurb.en: Teaches the wild man bread, beer and human thought.
blurb.zh: 教野人吃麵包、飲啤酒、思考人事。

quip.en: You are like a god now.

role.en: Gardener who violated Inanna in her sleep
role.zh: 褻瀆沉睡伊南娜的園丁

blurb.en: A nobody whose crime hides him nowhere on earth.
blurb.zh: 無名小卒，罪行卻使其無處藏身。

quip.en: Let me at least see the sun.
quip.zh: 至少讓我再見一次太陽。

role.en: Summer, one of the quarrelling brothers
role.zh: 「夏」，爭執兄弟之一

blurb.en: Claims the yield of heat: trees, bricks, cities.
blurb.zh: 自誇炎熱的收穫：林木、磚瓦、城邑。

role.en: Winter, the patient farmer
role.zh: 「冬」，耐心的農夫

blurb.en: Stores the grain and the cattle feed under the frozen field.
blurb.zh: 在凍土之下貯存五穀與牲畜之食。
